description: Source code for configuring and translating DU low-level configurations in a 3GPP radio system, including functions for generating and filling configurations related to physical layer parameters, PRACH, and worker management.

methods.name: generate_du_low_config
methods.description: Generates a detailed DU low configuration based on input unit configuration and cell configurations, setting parameters for PHY, PRACH, and processing pipelines.

methods.name: generate_o_du_low_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to generate and assign the DU low configuration to an output structure.

methods.name: fill_du_low_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Fills worker manager configuration with parameters derived from DU low unit configuration, including hardware acceleration overrides.
